tests: check-dual-review with --base excludes by name verdicts whose declared head the merge base already contains, so an unreviewed delivery-only change on top of a reviewed pair is red

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Real output of git rev-parse --show-prefix and git diff -z --no-renames --name-only base...head, the two commands classifyReviewBudget runs, captured 2026-09-23 against a scratch repository with the project nested at kernel/; the named tests stage that repository again and compare git's live output with the recorded stdout before trusting the classifier with it.
